sections.heading: 2. Sprint Burnup
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-124/fig-04.png)

Sprint Burnup - 62 of 103 points closed, with the closing burst landing on the last two days - [Sprint Burnup · TinaCloud](https://github.com/orgs/tinacms/projects/38/insights/4)

sections.heading: 4. Application Health
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-124/fig-05.png)

Application Health Dashboard Overview - Identity API HTTP 500s increased from 7 to 20. Content API HTTP 500s dropped from 2.41K to 733 - [TinaCloud CloudWatch Dashboard](https://us-east-1.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=us-east-1#dashboards/dashboard/tinacloud-overview)

sections.heading: 5. TinaCloud PostHog Metrics
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-124/fig-06.png)

Total Commits processed by TinaCloud over the last 6 months, total commits (aka spits) over the last month was 39,261 (up 8.65% on the previous period) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

![](/uploads/sprint-124/fig-07.png)

User onboarding over the last 7 days - our conversion metric is the share who go on to commit. New accounts were 9.7% last Sprint and are now 13.3% (17 of 128). Invited collaborators were 18.8% and are now 21.9% (23 of 105) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

![](/uploads/sprint-124/fig-08.png)

Organisation and project creation over the last 7 days - 128 new organisations, level with 128 last Sprint - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

sections.heading: 6. TinaCMS PostHog Metrics
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-124/fig-09.png)

Daily active users this month - peaking at 658 on 15 Sep (dips are weekends) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/1284436)

![](/uploads/sprint-124/fig-10.png)

Distribution of unique TinaCMS users over the past 30 days - US is our top country based on user-base with 1,699, ahead of Germany on 549 and the UK on 438 - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/1284436)
